description: The Comicgen Power BI lets you control the characters, emotions, poses, etc from data. Happy people can accompany good news on charts. Users can show two or less KPI's at a time, Each can be visualized as emotion (e.g., happy or sad) and pose (e.g., Thumbs Up or Angry). You can choose to keep the visual emotion or pose or both static to your choice by selecting appropriate emotion and pose from the Visual settings. Users can choose different Comics, Currently, it supports Dee & Dey. We are working on adding more comics. This component can be used as data-driven or static visualization. This is an open-source visual. Get the code from GitHub: https://github.com/gramener/comicgen-powerbi
